nodes.name: types.h
nodes.summary: Defines fundamental integer types (int8_t, uint8_t, int16_t, uint16_t, int32_t, uint32_t, int64_t, uint64_t), string typedef, and size_t in the myos::common namespace. Platform abstraction layer for type definitions used throughout the kernel.

nodes.name: kernel.cpp
nodes.summary: Main kernel entry point. Initializes GDT, memory manager, interrupt handling, syscalls, PCI bus, drivers (keyboard, mouse, ATA), FAT filesystem, GUI desktop, and networking stack (Ethernet, ARP, IPv4, ICMP, UDP, TCP). Contains VGA text-mode printf utilities, keyboard/mouse/TCP/UDP handler classes, and the kernelMain function.

nodes.name: memorymanagement.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements a free-list-based memory allocator (MemoryManager::malloc/free) and global operator new/delete overrides that delegate to the active MemoryManager singleton.

nodes.name: memorymanagement.h
nodes.summary: Declares the MemoryChunk struct (linked-list node for free list) and MemoryManager class with static activeMemoryManager singleton, malloc, and free. Also declares global operator new/delete variants.

nodes.name: arp.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements the Address Resolution Protocol (ARP): handles incoming ARP request/response messages, broadcasts MAC addresses, resolves IP to MAC using an internal cache, and sends ARP requests.

nodes.name: arp.h
nodes.summary: Declares the ARP message struct (AddressResolutionProtocolMessage) and AddressResolutionProtocol class inheriting EtherFrameHandler, with IP-MAC cache and resolve/broadcast methods.

nodes.name: etherframe.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements EtherFrameHandler (base class for ethertype-specific handlers) and EtherFrameProvider that wraps an amd_am79c973 NIC driver. Dispatches incoming Ethernet frames to registered handlers by etherType, and provides Send/GetIPAddress/GetMACAddress methods.

nodes.name: etherframe.h
nodes.summary: Declares the EtherFrameHeader struct (dstMAC, srcMAC, etherType), EtherFrameFooter typedef, EtherFrameHandler base class, and EtherFrameProvider class inheriting RawDataHandler. Provides the handler dispatch mechanism.

nodes.name: icmp.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements the Internet Control Message Protocol (ICMP): handles ping echo requests (type 8) by replying with echo replies (type 0), and provides RequestEchoReply to send pings.

nodes.name: icmp.h
nodes.summary: Declares the InternetControlMessageProtocolMessage struct (type, code, checksum, data) and InternetControlMessageProtocol class inheriting InternetProtocolHandler.

nodes.name: ipv4.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements InternetProtocolHandler (base for transport protocols) and InternetProtocolProvider. Handles IPv4 packet routing including header checksum calculation, subnet-based routing via gateway, and dispatching to protocol handlers by IP protocol number.

nodes.name: ipv4.h
nodes.summary: Declares InternetProtocolV4Message struct (IPv4 header fields), InternetProtocolHandler base class, and InternetProtocolProvider class inheriting EtherFrameHandler with ARP integration and checksum utility.

nodes.name: tcp.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements the full TCP state machine including connection establishment (SYN/SYN-ACK/ACK), data transfer, and teardown (FIN/ACK/CLOSE). Provides TransmissionControlProtocolProvider with Connect, Listen, Bind, Disconnect, Send operations and socket state management.

nodes.name: tcp.h
nodes.summary: Declares TCP socket states enum, flag enum, header/pseudo-header structs, and TransmissionControlProtocolHandler, TransmissionControlProtocolSocket, TransmissionControlProtocolProvider classes. Provider inherits InternetProtocolHandler.

nodes.name: udp.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements UDP datagram handling: UserDatagramProtocolProvider with Connect, Listen, Bind, Disconnect, Send operations and socket management. Dispatches received datagrams to registered handlers.

nodes.name: udp.h
nodes.summary: Declares UserDatagramProtocolHeader struct, and UserDatagramProtocolHandler, UserDatagramProtocolSocket, UserDatagramProtocolProvider classes. Provider inherits InternetProtocolHandler.

nodes.name: MemoryChunk
nodes.summary: Linked-list node for the free-list memory allocator. Contains next/prev pointers, allocated flag, and size field.

nodes.name: MemoryManager
nodes.summary: Free-list-based heap memory manager with static activeMemoryManager singleton. Provides malloc/free for kernel heap allocation.

nodes.name: EtherFrameHeader
nodes.summary: Ethernet frame header with 48-bit dstMAC, 48-bit srcMAC, and 16-bit etherType (big-endian bit-fields).

nodes.name: EtherFrameHandler
nodes.summary: Base class for ethertype-specific protocol handlers. Registers itself with EtherFrameProvider to receive frames matching its etherType.

nodes.name: EtherFrameProvider
nodes.summary: Wraps an amd_am79c973 NIC driver, dispatches incoming Ethernet frames to registered EtherFrameHandler instances by etherType. Inherits RawDataHandler.

nodes.name: AddressResolutionProtocolMessage
nodes.summary: ARP message structure with hardware type, protocol type, hardware/protocol address sizes, command (request/response), source/destination MAC and IP addresses.

nodes.name: AddressResolutionProtocol
nodes.summary: ARP protocol handler. Maintains an IP-to-MAC cache and provides resolve, request, and broadcast functionality. Inherits EtherFrameHandler.

nodes.name: InternetProtocolV4Message
nodes.summary: IPv4 packet header with version, header length, ToS, total length, identification, flags/offset, TTL, protocol, checksum, source/destination IP addresses.

nodes.name: InternetProtocolHandler
nodes.summary: Base class for transport-layer protocol handlers (TCP, UDP, ICMP). Registers with InternetProtocolProvider and provides Send/OnInternetProtocolReceived.

nodes.name: InternetProtocolProvider
nodes.summary: IPv4 routing layer. Handles incoming IP packets and dispatches to protocol handlers. Routes outgoing packets via gateway based on subnet mask. Uses ARP for MAC resolution. Provides static Checksum utility.

nodes.name: InternetControlMessageProtocolMessage
nodes.summary: ICMP message structure with type (echo request/reply), code, checksum, and data payload.

nodes.name: InternetControlMessageProtocol
nodes.summary: ICMP protocol handler implementing ping echo request/reply. Inherits InternetProtocolHandler.

nodes.name: UserDatagramProtocolHeader
nodes.summary: UDP header with source port, destination port, length, and checksum.

nodes.name: UserDatagramProtocolHandler
nodes.summary: Base handler for UDP datagrams. Subclasses override HandleUserDatagramProtocolMessage to process received UDP data.

nodes.name: UserDatagramProtocolSocket
nodes.summary: UDP socket with remote/local IP/port, backend reference, handler, and listening flag. Provides Send, Disconnect, message handling.

nodes.name: UserDatagramProtocolProvider
nodes.summary: UDP provider managing up to 65535 sockets. Supports Connect, Listen, Bind, Disconnect, Send. Dispatches received datagrams to bound handlers. Inherits InternetProtocolHandler.

nodes.name: TransmissionControlProtocolSocketState
nodes.summary: TCP socket state machine enum: CLOSED, LISTEN, SYN_SENT, SYN_RECEIVED, ESTABLISHED, FIN_WAIT1, FIN_WAIT2, CLOSING, TIME_WAIT, CLOSE_WAIT.

nodes.name: TransmissionControlProtocolFlag
nodes.summary: TCP flag bit values: FIN (1), SYN (2), RST (4), PSH (8), ACK (16), URG (32), ECE (64), CWR (128), NS (256).

nodes.name: TransmissionControlProtocolHeader
nodes.summary: TCP segment header with source/destination ports, sequence/acknowledgement numbers, header size, flags, window size, checksum, urgent pointer, and options.

nodes.name: TransmissionControlProtocolPseudoHeader
nodes.summary: TCP pseudo-header used for checksum calculation (srcIP, dstIP, protocol, totalLength).

nodes.name: TransmissionControlProtocolHandler
nodes.summary: Base handler for TCP connections. Subclasses override HandleTransmissionControlProtocolMessage to process received TCP data.

nodes.name: TransmissionControlProtocolSocket
nodes.summary: TCP socket with remote/local IP/port, sequence/acknowledgement numbers, state machine, backend, and handler. Provides Send, Disconnect, and message dispatch.

nodes.name: TransmissionControlProtocolProvider
nodes.summary: Full TCP provider implementing the TCP state machine. Manages up to 65535 sockets. Supports Connect (SYN), Listen (passive open), Bind, Disconnect (FIN), Send with flag control. Inherits InternetProtocolHandler.

nodes.name: PrintfKeyboardEventHandler
nodes.summary: Keyboard event handler that prints pressed characters to the VGA text-mode console. Inherits KeyboardEventHandler.

nodes.name: MouseToConsole
nodes.summary: Mouse event handler that renders a cursor on the VGA text-mode console using character attribute bit manipulation. Inherits MouseEventHandler.

nodes.name: PrintfUDPHandler
nodes.summary: UDP handler that prints received UDP datagram payload to the VGA console. Inherits UserDatagramProtocolHandler.

nodes.name: PrintfTCPHandler
nodes.summary: TCP handler that prints received data to console and responds to HTTP GET / with a static HTML page. Inherits TransmissionControlProtocolHandler.

nodes.name: printf
nodes.summary: Writes a null-terminated string to the VGA text-mode buffer at 0xB8000. Handles newlines, scrolling, and 80x25 character grid.

nodes.name: printfHex
nodes.summary: Prints a single byte as two hex digits using printf.

nodes.name: printfHex16
nodes.summary: Prints a 16-bit value as four hex digits using printfHex.

nodes.name: printfHex32
nodes.summary: Prints a 32-bit value as eight hex digits using printfHex.

nodes.name: sysprintf
nodes.summary: System call wrapper that invokes int 0x80 with function code 4 to print a string via the kernel's syscall handler.

nodes.name: taskA
nodes.summary: Test task that continuously prints 'A' via sysprintf.

nodes.name: taskB
nodes.summary: Test task that continuously prints 'B' via sysprintf.

nodes.name: callConstructors
nodes.summary: Iterates from start_ctors to end_ctors and calls each global constructor. Called before kernelMain.

nodes.name: kernelMain
nodes.summary: Main kernel entry point. Initializes GDT, MemoryManager, InterruptManager, SyscallHandler, DriverManager (keyboard, mouse, PCI, ATA), FAT filesystem, and full networking stack (Ethernet, ARP, IPv4, ICMP, UDP, TCP). Enters main loop.

nodes.name: MemoryManager::malloc
nodes.summary: Allocates a block of memory from the free-list. Splits chunks if remaining space is large enough. Returns null if no suitable chunk found.

nodes.name: MemoryManager::free
nodes.summary: Frees a previously allocated block. Coalesces adjacent free chunks to reduce fragmentation.

nodes.name: MemoryManager::MemoryManager
nodes.summary: Constructs the memory manager with a start address and size, initializing the free-list with a single chunk. Sets itself as the activeMemoryManager.

nodes.name: MemoryManager::~MemoryManager
nodes.summary: Destructor. Clears activeMemoryManager if it points to this instance.

nodes.name: operator new(unsigned)
nodes.summary: Global operator new that delegates to MemoryManager::activeMemoryManager->malloc.

nodes.name: operator new[](unsigned)
nodes.summary: Global array operator new that delegates to MemoryManager::activeMemoryManager->malloc.

nodes.name: operator new(unsigned, void*)
nodes.summary: Placement new that returns the pointer argument unchanged.

nodes.name: operator new[](unsigned, void*)
nodes.summary: Placement array new that returns the pointer argument unchanged.

nodes.name: operator delete(void*)
nodes.summary: Global operator delete that delegates to MemoryManager::activeMemoryManager->free.

nodes.name: operator delete[](void*)
nodes.summary: Global array operator delete that delegates to MemoryManager::activeMemoryManager->free.

nodes.name: EtherFrameHandler::EtherFrameHandler
nodes.summary: Constructs an EtherFrameHandler, converting etherType to big-endian and registering with the backend provider.

nodes.name: EtherFrameHandler::Send
nodes.summary: Sends data over Ethernet by calling backend->Send with the handler's etherType.

nodes.name: EtherFrameHandler::OnEtherFrameReceived
nodes.summary: Default handler returns false (no response). Override in subclass to process received Ethernet frames.

nodes.name: EtherFrameHandler::GetIPAddress
nodes.summary: Returns the IP address from the backend NIC driver.

nodes.name: EtherFrameProvider::EtherFrameProvider
nodes.summary: Constructs EtherFrameProvider wrapping an amd_am79c973 NIC driver. Initializes all handler slots to null.

nodes.name: EtherFrameProvider::OnRawDataReceived
nodes.summary: Called by the NIC driver when raw data arrives. Parses EtherFrameHeader, dispatches to registered handler by etherType, and optionally sends back response frames.

nodes.name: EtherFrameProvider::Send
nodes.summary: Constructs an Ethernet frame with header, copies payload, and sends via backend NIC driver. Allocates and frees temporary buffer via MemoryManager.

nodes.name: EtherFrameProvider::GetMACAddress
nodes.summary: Returns the MAC address from the backend NIC driver.

nodes.name: EtherFrameProvider::GetIPAddress
nodes.summary: Returns the IP address from the backend NIC driver.

nodes.name: EtherFrameHandler::~EtherFrameHandler
nodes.summary: Unregisters this handler from the backend provider.

nodes.name: EtherFrameProvider::~EtherFrameProvider
nodes.summary: Empty destructor.

nodes.name: AddressResolutionProtocol::AddressResolutionProtocol
nodes.summary: Constructs ARP handler with etherType 0x806 and initializes cache entry count to 0.

nodes.name: AddressResolutionProtocol::OnEtherFrameReceived
nodes.summary: Processes incoming ARP messages. Handles ARP requests (replies with MAC) and ARP responses (updates cache).

nodes.name: AddressResolutionProtocol::BroadcastMACAddress
nodes.summary: Sends an ARP response (gratuitous ARP) announcing this host's MAC to the given IP.

nodes.name: AddressResolutionProtocol::RequestMACAddress
nodes.summary: Sends an ARP request to resolve an IP address to a MAC. Uses broadcast destination MAC.

nodes.name: AddressResolutionProtocol::GetMACFromCache
nodes.summary: Looks up an IP in the ARP cache and returns the corresponding MAC, or broadcast MAC if not found.

nodes.name: AddressResolutionProtocol::Resolve
nodes.summary: Resolves an IP to a MAC by checking cache first, then sending an ARP request and polling until resolution.

nodes.name: InternetProtocolHandler::InternetProtocolHandler
nodes.summary: Registers this handler with InternetProtocolProvider for a specific IP protocol number.

nodes.name: InternetProtocolHandler::Send
nodes.summary: Sends data to a destination IP by delegating to the InternetProtocolProvider with this handler's protocol number.

nodes.name: InternetProtocolHandler::OnInternetProtocolReceived
nodes.summary: Default handler returns false. Override in subclass to process received IP packets.

nodes.name: InternetProtocolProvider::InternetProtocolProvider
nodes.summary: Constructs IPv4 provider with etherType 0x800, initializes handler table, stores ARP reference, gateway IP, and subnet mask.

nodes.name: InternetProtocolProvider::OnEtherFrameReceived
nodes.summary: Processes incoming IPv4 frames, validates destination IP, dispatches payload to registered protocol handler. Supports response by swapping source/destination IP and recalculating checksum.

nodes.name: InternetProtocolProvider::Send
nodes.summary: Constructs an IPv4 packet with header, calculates checksum, routes via gateway if destination is not on local subnet, and sends via ARP-resolved MAC address.

nodes.name: InternetProtocolProvider::Checksum
nodes.summary: Static method computing the Internet checksum (16-bit one's complement) over arbitrary data. Handles odd byte length.

nodes.name: InternetControlMessageProtocol::InternetControlMessageProtocol
nodes.summary: Constructs ICMP handler with protocol number 0x01.

nodes.name: InternetControlMessageProtocol::OnInternetProtocolReceived
nodes.summary: Processes ICMP messages: handles echo requests (type 8) by sending echo replies (type 0), and prints ping responses (type 0).

nodes.name: InternetControlMessageProtocol::RequestEchoReply
nodes.summary: Sends an ICMP echo request (ping) to the specified IP address with data payload 0x3713.

nodes.name: UserDatagramProtocolHandler::UserDatagramProtocolHandler
nodes.summary: Empty constructor.

nodes.name: UserDatagramProtocolSocket::UserDatagramProtocolSocket
nodes.summary: Constructs a UDP socket with backend reference, null handler, and listening=false.

nodes.name: UserDatagramProtocolSocket::HandleUserDatagramProtocolMessage
nodes.summary: Delegates incoming UDP data to the bound handler if set.

nodes.name: UserDatagramProtocolSocket::Send
nodes.summary: Sends UDP data via the backend provider.

nodes.name: UserDatagramProtocolSocket::Disconnect
nodes.summary: Disconnects the socket via the backend provider.

nodes.name: UserDatagramProtocolProvider::UserDatagramProtocolProvider
nodes.summary: Constructs UDP provider with protocol 0x11, initializing socket table and free port starting at 1024.

nodes.name: UserDatagramProtocolProvider::OnInternetProtocolReceived
nodes.summary: Dispatches received IP data to matching UDP socket by port. Supports both listening and connected sockets.

nodes.name: UserDatagramProtocolProvider::Connect
nodes.summary: Creates and returns a connected UDP socket with the specified remote IP and port. Assigns an ephemeral local port.

nodes.name: UserDatagramProtocolProvider::Listen
nodes.summary: Creates a listening UDP socket on the specified local port.

nodes.name: UserDatagramProtocolProvider::Disconnect
nodes.summary: Removes the socket from the provider's socket table and frees its memory.

nodes.name: UserDatagramProtocolProvider::Send
nodes.summary: Builds a UDP datagram with header, copies payload, and sends via InternetProtocolHandler.

nodes.name: UserDatagramProtocolProvider::Bind
nodes.summary: Binds a UDP handler to a socket for incoming message delivery.

nodes.name: TransmissionControlProtocolHandler::TransmissionControlProtocolHandler
nodes.summary: Empty constructor.

nodes.name: TransmissionControlProtocolSocket::TransmissionControlProtocolSocket
nodes.summary: Constructs a TCP socket with backend reference, null handler, and CLOSED state.

nodes.name: TransmissionControlProtocolSocket::HandleTransmissionControlProtocolMessage
nodes.summary: Delegates received TCP data to the bound handler if set.

nodes.name: TransmissionControlProtocolSocket::Send
nodes.summary: Waits until connection is ESTABLISHED, then sends data with PSH|ACK flags via the backend.

nodes.name: TransmissionControlProtocolSocket::Disconnect
nodes.summary: Initiates TCP disconnect by delegating to the backend provider.

nodes.name: TransmissionControlProtocolProvider::TransmissionControlProtocolProvider
nodes.summary: Constructs TCP provider with protocol 0x06, initializing socket table and free port starting at 1024.

nodes.name: bigEndian32
nodes.summary: File-scope utility converting a 32-bit value from host to big-endian byte order.

nodes.name: TransmissionControlProtocolProvider::OnInternetProtocolReceived
nodes.summary: Full TCP state machine handler. Processes SYN, SYN-ACK, ACK, FIN, RST flags, manages socket state transitions (LISTEN, SYN_SENT, SYN_RECEIVED, ESTABLISHED, FIN_WAIT, CLOSE_WAIT, CLOSED), handles data delivery with sequence number verification, and sends RST on errors.

nodes.name: TransmissionControlProtocolProvider::Send
nodes.summary: Builds a TCP segment with header, pseudo-header for checksum, options (MSS for SYN), and sends via InternetProtocolHandler.

nodes.name: TransmissionControlProtocolProvider::Connect
nodes.summary: Initiates a TCP connection by creating a socket in SYN_SENT state and sending a SYN segment.

nodes.name: TransmissionControlProtocolProvider::Disconnect
nodes.summary: Initiates graceful TCP teardown by transitioning socket to FIN_WAIT1 and sending FIN+ACK.

nodes.name: TransmissionControlProtocolProvider::Listen
nodes.summary: Creates a listening TCP socket on the specified port in LISTEN state.

nodes.name: TransmissionControlProtocolProvider::Bind
nodes.summary: Binds a TCP handler to a socket for incoming data delivery.

edges.languageNotes: typedef used by types in struct
MemoryManager uses MemoryChunk for free-list nodes
calls printf to print hex digits
sends request if not in cache
sends ARP reply via base class
